newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia's bourse ends session 0.32 pct higher.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia's bourse ends session 0.32 pct higher.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Tuesday closed up by 0.32 percent for its second conscutive gain, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 444.22 points, up from 442.80 on Monday.
Volume traded was still thin with 348,948 dinars on Tuesday against 329,150 dinars the previous day.
Cola and beer bottler Societe Frigorifique et Brasserie de Tunis gained 0.7 dinar to 76.2 dinars.
Union Bancaire pour le Commerce et l'Industrie was up 0.38 dinar to 40.2.
Detergents firm SPCD gained 0.36 dinar to 29.52. Airline Tunis Air rose 0.3 dinar to 18.8. Palm Beach Hotels advanced 0.2 dinar to 9.2.
Leasing firm Tunisie Leasing was up 0.16 dinar to 30.4 after it announced that its first half pretax profits jumped by 50 percent over the same 1996 period.
Chemical firm Alkimia rose 0.1 dinar to 42.5.
Banque Nationale de Developpement Touristique was down 0.23 dinar to 8.15. Banque Internationale Arabe de Tunisie bank edged 0.16 dinar lower to 28.84.
Most of the trade was in Banque du Sud with 7,686 shares changing hands at an unchanged 10.34 dinars. ($1=1.157 dinar)
